description.value: The Moose has been a dive bar and rock 'n' roll institution in the heart of downtown Vancouver since 2001, its walls lined with decades of rock memorabilia and its jukebox loaded with heavy metal and classic rock. The kitchen turns out Canadian pub staples — burgers, crispy wings, ribs, and all-day breakfast — making it a no-frills but satisfying refuelling stop for cyclists moving through the city core. The bar is wheelchair accessible and does not take reservations.
